decisions.summary: Map tier-2 dependencies and qualify alternates for parts fed through a single tier-2 supplier after the Fox Inc [SYNTH] fire

messages.author: EMP-N-002
messages.text: Fox Inc [SYNTH] had a fire overnight. They are a tier-2 supplier but feed a lot of our tier-1s.

messages.author: EMP-N-008
messages.text: We had no idea how many parts depend on them. We need a tier-2 map.
